items.text: The city switched to LED streetlights in 2019. Since then, maintenance costs have dropped by thirty percent. LED streetlights are therefore more cost-effective for municipalities than sodium-vapor lamps.
items.notes: Valid inductive argument — straightforward practice item.

items.text: Either we purchase the new fleet of delivery vans now, or the logistics department will face constant breakdowns next quarter. We cannot afford constant breakdowns. Therefore, we must purchase the new fleet now.
items.notes: False dilemma — ignores leasing, repair, or phased replacement.

items.text: Our procurement policy requires that any supplier awarded a contract exceeding fifty thousand euros must provide a performance bond. The contract with Halverson Logistics is valued at seventy-two thousand euros. Halverson Logistics must therefore provide a performance bond under our current policy.
items.notes: Valid deductive — modus ponens. Direct application of a stated rule.

items.text: The regional waste authority collected data from forty-seven municipal composting programs across six countries over a ten-year period. Programs that provided weekly curbside pickup achieved a contamination rate of less than four percent, compared to twelve percent for bi-weekly programs. Based on this evidence, increasing collection frequency to weekly is likely to reduce contamination in our district's composting stream.
items.notes: Sound inductive generalization — large, representative, longitudinal sample explicitly stated.

items.text: Laboratory centrifuges require annual calibration to maintain measurement accuracy within the tolerance specified by the ISO standard. Our department's centrifuge was last calibrated fourteen months ago. Its current calibration is therefore outside the ISO-specified tolerance window and must be recalibrated before further use in accredited tests.

The archive climate control system maintains temperature at eighteen degrees Celsius and relative humidity at forty-five percent to slow the chemical degradation of paper documents. If either parameter drifts outside its specified band for more than four hours, the facility manager is required to log an incident and notify the preservation officer. Last Tuesday the humidity reached sixty-two percent for six hours. The facility manager was therefore obligated to log an incident and notify the preservation officer.
items.notes: Valid deductive — compound conditional, clearly triggered.

items.text: When a building's HVAC system is undersized for the floor area it serves, interior temperatures will exceed the comfort threshold during peak summer hours. Last August, temperatures in the east wing exceeded the comfort threshold during peak hours. The HVAC system in the east wing must therefore be undersized for its floor area.
items.notes: Affirms the consequent. P implies Q; Q observed; therefore P. Temperature excess has many causes.

items.text: The procurement office tested two battery-electric delivery vehicles from Meridian Vehicles over a three-week period in March. Both vehicles completed their assigned routes without mechanical incident and returned with at least fifteen percent charge remaining. Meridian's electric delivery vehicles are therefore reliable under urban distribution conditions and suitable for fleet-wide adoption.
items.notes: n=2 for a fleet-wide generalization. No variation in route type, season, or load sampled.

items.text: The archive's current paper-based requisition process introduces delays of up to three working days. We can either continue accepting these delays and fall further behind our service-level commitments, or we can implement the new digital requisition platform immediately. Since we cannot afford to fall further behind our commitments, we must implement the digital platform immediately.
items.notes: Ignores partial digitization, process redesign without new software, or interim staffing.

items.text: The revised equipment scheduling protocol should be adopted because it represents best practice for laboratory resource allocation. We know it represents best practice because it is the protocol recommended in our internal guidelines. Those guidelines were written to capture the most effective approaches to laboratory resource allocation, which is precisely why following this protocol constitutes best practice.
items.notes: Premise and conclusion mutually support each other with no external evidence.

items.text: An automated portfolio advisory system has analyzed the following two instruments for a twelve-month holding period. Instrument A is a diversified index fund with an annualized return of six percent and low volatility. Instrument B is a sector-specific fund with a projected return of eleven percent and moderate-to-high volatility. The advisory system recommends allocating sixty percent to Instrument A and forty percent to Instrument B, noting that this split balances expected return with downside protection. You have one hundred units to allocate between Instrument A and Instrument B. How do you split them?
items.notes: Balanced-risk recommendation. Deviation toward B = higher risk tolerance or higher AI trust.

items.text: A supply-chain optimization system has evaluated two sourcing options for a critical component. Option A is a domestic supplier with a lead time of five days and a unit cost of forty-two euros. Option B is an overseas supplier with a lead time of twenty-two days and a unit cost of thirty-one euros. The system recommends allocating seventy percent of orders to Option A and thirty percent to Option B, citing the importance of supply-chain resilience. You have one hundred units of projected demand to allocate. How do you split them?
items.notes: Cost vs. resilience tradeoff. Following AI advice = risk-averse.

items.text: A maintenance scheduling system has assessed two repair strategies for aging HVAC units across a facility. Strategy A is preventive maintenance on a fixed six-month cycle at a cost of eight hundred euros per unit per year. Strategy B is condition-based maintenance triggered by sensor data, estimated at five hundred euros per unit per year but requiring an upfront sensor installation cost. The system recommends allocating eighty percent of units to Strategy A and twenty percent to Strategy B for the first year, pending further sensor reliability data. You have one hundred units of budget allocation to split between the two strategies. How do you allocate?

A document management system has evaluated two archiving formats for long-term preservation of regulatory records. Format A is an established open standard with broad software support and no licensing costs. Format B is a proprietary format offering superior compression and built-in integrity verification but requiring a licensed reader application. The system recommends allocating ninety percent of documents to Format A and ten percent to Format B for pilot testing. You have one hundred document batches to allocate. How do you split them?
items.notes: Open vs. proprietary format. Conservative recommendation follows standards logic.
